# TRC Healthcare

> > TRC Healthcare provides ACPE-accredited continuing education, clinical decision support, and compliance training for pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, and healthcare professionals.

TRC Healthcare offers comprehensive solutions including Pharmacist's Letter, Pharmacy Technician's Letter, NetCE All Access, and CriticalPoint for medication management, USP compliance, and professional development across hospital and retail pharmacy settings.

## Key Topics

- ACPE-accredited continuing education
- Pharmacist's Letter
- Pharmacy Technician's Letter
- NetCE All Access
- Hospital pharmacy solutions
- USP <797> compounding compliance
- Medication therapy management
- Type 2 diabetes treatment
- GLP-1 agonists and SGLT-2 inhibitors
- Pharmacy technician certification
- Clinical decision support
- CriticalPoint compliance
- NatMed Pro natural medicines
- Immunization training
- Healthcare professional development

## Core Products & Solutions

- [Pharmacist's Letter CE & Medication Resources](https://trchealthcare.com/product/pharmacists-letter): Pharmacist's Letter: ACPE-accredited CE and medication therapy resources
- [Healthcare CE Training for Hospital Pharmacies: Tailored CE & Clinical Decision Support | TRC Healthcare](https://trchealthcare.com/industries/hospital-pharmacy-solutions): Hospital pharmacy CE training, clinical decision support & compliance solutions
- [Pharmacy Technician's Letter CE - TRC Healthcare](https://trchealthcare.com/product/pharmacy-technicians-letter-ce): Pharmacy Technician's Letter CE courses and training subscription
- [Build Pharmacy Technician Talent That Lasts | TRC Healthcare](https://trchealthcare.com/group-purchases/pharmacy-technician-suite): Pharmacy Technician Learning Suite: onboarding, certification & CE training
- [Continuing Education Special Offers Advanced Practice Registered Nurses](https://trchealthcare.com/product/all-access-aprn): NetCE APRN continuing education courses with state-specific requirements
- [Pharmacy Technician's Letter Live Webinars - TRC Healthcare](https://trchealthcare.com/product/pharmacy-technicians-letter-live-webinars): Live webinar CE training for pharmacy technicians

## Clinical Education & Webinars

- [First-Line Options for Type 2 Diabetes](https://trchealthcare.com/first-line-options-for-type-2-diabetes): Expert panel webinar on type 2 diabetes first-line treatment options
- [Clinical Capsules: Diabetes Treatment Debate: Should Metformin Still Be Used First? - TRC Healthcare](https://trchealthcare.com/clinical-capsules-diabetes-treatment-debate-should-metformin-still-be-used-first): Metformin vs SGLT-2/GLP-1 agonists as first-line type 2 diabetes therapy
- [Medication Talk: Meds After Acute Coronary Syndrome - TRC Healthcare](https://trchealthcare.com/medication-talk-meds-after-acute-coronary-syndrome): CE webinar on post-heart attack medications: antiplatelets to statins
- [Clinical Capsules: Walk Through Updated Guidelines for Restless Legs Syndrome - TRC Healthcare](https://trchealthcare.com/clinical-capsules-walk-through-updated-guidelines-for-restless-legs-syndrome): Updated RLS management guidelines: iron checks, dopamine agonist alternatives
- [Mental Health Treatments Using Natural Medicines | TRC Healthcare](https://trchealthcare.com/blog-mental-health-treatments-using-natural-medicines): Natural medicines for mental health: kava, saffron, ashwagandha evidence

## Compliance & Compounding Training

- [USP Isn't Just for Pharmacies—Here's Who's Still at Risk](https://trchealthcare.com/the-compounding-chronicles-usp-isnt-just-for-pharmacies-heres-whos-still-at-risk): USP <800> hazardous drug safety in veterinary oncology settings
